name: rixmerz
description: Rixmerz Claude Code marketplace — owner namespace hosting the flowtrace, livespec, vise, mini-vise, eyes, dwg-engine, layout-inspector and android-layout-inspector plugins. Each plugin lives in its own repository; this repo only indexes them.

plugins.name: flowtrace
plugins.description: Runtime tracing for AI-assisted debugging: instruments Java, Python, Node and TypeScript without touching the source, then reads flowtrace.jsonl.

plugins.name: livespec
plugins.description: Code intelligence + Spec traceability: livespec MCP server, specialized subagent, and preloaded Skill.

plugins.name: mini-vise
plugins.description: Spec-first pipeline — you write the proposal, three subagents walk it: dev, qa, review

plugins.name: vise
plugins.description: Phase-gated workflow enforcer, cross-project experience memory, and git snapshots for Claude Code

plugins.name: eyes
plugins.description: Temporary visual eyes for agents on Hyprland/Wayland — capture monitors, windows, or regions and see the result inline as a PNG for QA.

plugins.name: dwg-engine
plugins.description: Generate real DWG files with no paid CAD — ezdxf + the free ODA File Converter packaged in Docker, exposed as MCP tools. Host needs only Docker.

plugins.name: layout-inspector
plugins.description: Spatial inspection of rendered web pages: finds overlapping components, off-screen clipping, truncated text and z-index conflicts by measuring the real layout in a headless browser, not by eyeballing screenshots.

plugins.name: android-layout-inspector
plugins.description: Spatial inspection of a live Android UI: finds overlapping views, off-screen clipping, touch targets under 48dp, controls covered by other controls and unlabeled clickables by measuring real uiautomator geometry over adb, not by eyeballing screenshots.
